description: Issue a link to the form where the person types the passwords and keys the project needs. Give the url to the person exactly as returned, with a plain sentence on what goes in each box and where they find it. Do not open it, do not follow it and do not relay its contents. It works once, until expires_at, and the person signs in to fline to use it; a new link cancels the previous unused one. Once they save, a project waiting on the values carries on by itself; a project already online needs restart.
name: get_secrets_link
title: Issue a secrets entry link
